why.secured_next_step_or_disqualified: L'agente ha tentato di fissare una demo, ma l'host ha rifiutato, chiedendo di ricevere una mail e di parlarne con il socio, senza che l'agente riuscisse a ottenere un impegno concreto per il passo successivo.

calls.good: Il rep ha spiegato chiaramente i tre principali benefici di Logify in modo conciso.
calls.fix: Chiedere domande di approfondimento sulle obiezioni per comprenderne meglio la radice prima di rispondere.
calls.summary: Host on Booking.com, Airbnb and direct (branch: 2-5 units, Hard, Chiara). Interested in automating the bureaucracy but hesitant on cost. Quoted €56/month for Ultimate yearly. Declined a demo to discuss with a business partner first; rep agreed to send an email.

calls.good: Le représentant a habilement identifié et approfondi le problème de la bureaucratie et du temps perdu par le prospect.
calls.fix: Accuser réception des objections initiales du prospect avant de poursuivre la découverte.
calls.summary: Marco, guesthouse owner in Florence, Booking.com, 70–80% occupancy, 4–5 hours a week on Italian admin. Sceptical about hidden fees and the Chekin partnership, but agreed to a 15–20 minute demo the next day at 2:30 PM.

why.objection_handled_laer: Le prospect a exprimé sa méfiance face à l'automatisation des lois italiennes. L'agent a écouté et reconnu la méfiance mais n'a pas eu le temps d'explorer ou de répondre pleinement avant la fin de l'appel.
why.secured_next_step_or_disqualified: La conversation s'est terminée abruptement sans qu'une prochaine étape concrète (démo, suivi) ne soit demandée ou sécurisée, ni une disqualification claire.
why.maintained_control_and_rapport: L'agent a maintenu un certain contrôle en posant des questions de découverte, mais le prospect était impatient et a coupé court à la fin, l'agent n'a pas réussi à le réengager pleinement.

calls.good: Le représentant a tenté de comprendre la situation actuelle du prospect et ses processus de gestion.
calls.fix: Mieux préparer les réponses aux objections spécifiques et techniques du prospect, notamment sur l'automatisation et la conformité légale.
calls.summary: Valentin, property owner happy with Booking.com, worried about extra work. Very sceptical that software could handle police declarations and tourist tax under Italian law. Call ended unresolved.

why.personalized_listing_opening: Opened on her Booking listing in Rome, the good reviews and the calendar not being full.
why.secured_next_step_or_disqualified: Proposed Friday for the demo, but the call dropped before a time was agreed.

calls.good: Spotted bureaucracy as a pain point and offered a specific solution, which opened her up.
calls.fix: Handle the opening objections better and keep the call going until the next step is closed.
calls.summary: 1 property in Rome, Booking.com only. Call dropped after the rep went silent. Thomas rated the call 5/5 and noted the prospect asked about the 12 months before he had mentioned them.

why.personalized_listing_opening: Generic: "calling about your property that's active on Booking". Nothing about the listing itself.
why.secured_next_step_or_disqualified: Offered a 30-minute Google Meet demo but never proposed a time.
why.value_before_price: Price was never discussed in detail.

calls.good: Found bureaucracy as the host's pain and tied Lodgify to it.
calls.fix: Dig into the implications of the problem before presenting the solution.
calls.summary: 2 apartments, Booking.com only. Call hit the 10-minute maximum.

why.personalized_listing_opening: Generic opening. The host had to ask who was calling.
why.discovery_before_pitch: Gave a generic pitch (occupancy, revenue, guest experience) before finding his pain.
why.objection_handled_laer: On "more platforms means more headaches" she acknowledged, then went to features without exploring.
why.secured_next_step_or_disqualified: He refused the demo: "If you can't even tell me how it works or what Chekin is, I'm not going to spend half an hour on a call."

calls.good: Acknowledged his resistance and validated his success with Booking.com.
calls.fix: Be ready to explain what Chekin does. He refused the demo because basic questions went unanswered.
calls.summary: Marco · B&B, 4 rooms, Booking.com, high occupancy

why.personalized_listing_opening: Opened on his Airbnb listing and the calendar not being fully booked.
why.uncovered_compliance_admin: Asked "Alloggiati Web? Tourist tax and invoices?" before pitching Chekin.

calls.good: Addressed his Italian compliance concern head-on, which was the turning point for the demo.
calls.fix: Ask sharper problem questions earlier, instead of leading with generic time savings.
calls.summary: Marco · Airbnb + Booking.com, 70–80% occupancy, manual calendars

why.uncovered_compliance_admin: Asked how she handles e-invoicing and guest registration before pitching.

calls.good: Tied the solution to her 3–4 hours a week on compliance, which led to the demo.
calls.fix: Ask about every booking channel she uses, not only Booking.com.
calls.summary: Maria · 3 apartments in Bologna, Booking.com only. Call ended with a connection timeout after the demo was agreed.

why.personalized_listing_opening: Complimented the property and reviews and pointed out the calendar wasn't fully booked.
why.compliance_hook_used_correctly: Compliance never came up, so marked as not applicable.

calls.good: Reframed value around commission and time savings, which got past the price objection.
calls.fix: Have a ballpark price, or offer to email it, when the prospect asks before agreeing to a demo.
calls.summary: 2 units, Booking.com + Airbnb, manual calendar sync

why.personalized_listing_opening: General hook for Italian hosts on Booking.com. Nothing about Giorgio's own property or reviews.
why.compliance_hook_used_correctly: Mentioned VAT registration but never used Alloggiati, tourist tax or e-invoicing as the hook.

calls.good: Handled the cost and setup objections by showing value and free onboarding.
calls.fix: Ask more situation and problem questions before pitching the solution.
calls.summary: Giorgio · Booking.com + Airbnb, no channel manager

why.personalized_listing_opening: Opened assuming Italy and Booking.com. The prospect corrected it straight away.
why.discovery_before_pitch: Pitched the general product right after the correction, before discovery.
why.compliance_hook_used_correctly: Prospect was in the UK, so compliance was not relevant.

calls.good: Reframed the "too much work" objection by asking how much time manual tasks take today.
calls.fix: Give a ballpark price range when the prospect asks for it directly.
calls.summary: Maria · 2 lets in Brighton, Airbnb only

why.personalized_listing_opening: Generic opening about Italian hosts with VAT on Booking.com. Nothing from the listing.
why.discovery_before_pitch: Said the host was "leaving money on the table" before asking about the setup.
why.compliance_hook_used_correctly: Compliance never came up, so marked as not applicable.

calls.good: Overcame the price objection by clearly showing the ROI and commission savings.
calls.fix: Quantify the time saved by linking it to specific things the host gets back.
